title: to3d
description: Creates 3D datasets for use with AFNI from 2D image files

type.description: Declare images to contain data of a given type
type.title: Image Type

geomparent.description: Read geometry data from dataset file
geomparent.title: Geometry Parent File

anatparent.description: Take anatomy parent from dataset file
anatparent.title: Anatomy Parent File

nowritebrik_flag.description: Suppress saving of the BRIK file
nowritebrik_flag.title: No Write BRIK Flag

xFOV.title: X-Axis FOV

yFOV.description: Specify size and orientation of the y-axis extent

zFOV.title: Z-Axis FOV

zorigin.description: Set the center of the first slice offset in z-axis

data_type.title: Data Type
